nodes.d: The right to decide any use of an asset not fixed by contract. The paper's own residual, and the thing ownership is identified with.
The claim on what is left after contractual claims are met. Conserved: extending one to a stakeholder takes it from the incumbent.
Investment worth more inside this relationship than outside it, and therefore hostage to it.
The share of future contingencies a contract cannot name. What makes a residual right worth holding at all.
The output a team produces that no member's separable contribution accounts for.
Exposure to shirking or externalities a stakeholder cannot contract away. The paper's criterion for who should hold a right.

claims.t: When contracts are incomplete, the allocation of residual rights of control matters
The party with residual control invests more in the relationship
A residual claim is what makes an investment worth making
Specific investment raises the surplus the relationship produces
Incompleteness deters the investment it cannot protect
A team's surplus is divided by a mediating hierarchy rather than by contract
claims.sc: publicly held corporations under US law

claims.t: Vulnerability unaddressed reduces what the team will produce
Stakeholders who are vulnerable to shirking or externalities should be given fixed or residual control rights
claims.sc: firms whose production is a team effort with non-separable contributions

meta.t: The central problem of governance is coalitional contracting over team production, and agency is one case of it rather than the frame.
The board is a mediating hierarchy and not an agent of shareholders.

lines.why: Seven papers report the association without reporting acceleration, and a survey factor pushed against an accounting outcome is far likelier to show diminishing returns than compounding ones.
The one paper that isolates clarity reports a null, so the least committal shape is the honest one: no curvature is claimed because none was found.
The direct productivity route should saturate: the first increment of mission recruits the employees most responsive to it.

The corpus says AUTHENTIC purpose makes work meaningful, and authenticity is a threshold: below it a stated mission is cheap talk and buys no meaningfulness, above it the effect arrives quickly and then saturates.
One term writes it, so the additive composition has one summand and the outcome stays inside [0, 1] by the term's own f(1)=1.

Nothing in the corpus states a curvature for the mediated leg, which is a reason to declare the FAMILY and not the line: linear is one member and naming it would assert that there is no curvature, which no paper here says either. Concave is what I will assert -- the first increments of meaningfulness convert fastest into measured performance -- and the gentlest member is the one to write inside it, so every conclusion is read against all five rather than against my guess.

Additive over three routes, divided by its weights so the outcome stays inside its declared [0, 1] everywhere in the weight box rather than only at the values picked. The clarity-only index is not a fourth route: it is declared GATES, and a gate multiplies the term it acts on, so clarity pays only where clarity alone is present. That is what the corpus's null for clarity without purpose bundling says, written as arithmetic.
An allocation rule splits proportionally unless something says otherwise, and nothing here does.

Declared as a modulator, so its own shape carries no commitment beyond rising from nothing to full -- and a line is a commitment: it says the gain is proportional. A threshold is the substantive guess for a verification technology, because capability that cannot yet verify allocates nothing and the useful range begins late, so the late member is written inside the sigmoid class and the conclusions are read against all five.

Two things, both from declarations. Measurement is declared MODULATES, which multiplies the term it acts on, so a commitment nobody can measure allocates nothing verifiable. And the quantity is declared a SHARE, so it cannot exceed what there is to allocate: the ceiling is the declaration made arithmetic. The cap is also where this model stops being differentiable, which the page will say rather than smooth over.

rows.text: firm accounting performance rises with purpose clarity factor over 75.0% of for every purpose clarity factor in [0.00, 1.00], and the rest of the range is not settled — no counter-example was found in it.
rows.anno: Clearer purpose pays, and the method could only prove it over three quarters of the range the scholar declared. Where it is proved, the gain is steepest at the low end: the first move from no clarity to some clarity buys more than any later one, which is what declaring a saturating shape for that route commits the model to. What it does not establish: It establishes nothing about the remaining quarter of the range, where the method could not settle the sign either way; that quarter is undecided, not a region where clarity stops paying.

rows.text: firm accounting performance rises with prosocial mission, for every prosocial mission in [0.00, 1.00].
rows.anno: A stronger prosocial mission raises firm performance across the whole declared range, by two routes at once: directly, through the productivity the corpus attributes to purpose-driven firms, and indirectly, through the meaningfulness employees report. The direct route saturates, so the first increment of mission does the most work. What it does not establish: It says nothing about how much: the sign is proved and the size is not, and no weight in this model is fixed by the corpus. Of the 3,125 declared combinations of functional form the search could settle 1,000, every one of which agreed; the other 2,125 are undecided rather than contrary.

rows.text: perceived work meaningfulness rises with prosocial mission, for every prosocial mission in [0.00, 1.00].
rows.anno: Mission makes work feel meaningful across the whole declared range, and the model was told this is a threshold rather than a proportion: below a level of authenticity a stated mission buys almost no meaningfulness, and above it the effect arrives quickly and then levels off. That shape is a declaration read off the corpus's insistence on AUTHENTIC purpose, not something the data fixed. What it does not establish: Where the threshold sits is declared, not measured. The corpus says authenticity matters and never says at what level, so the particular sigmoid is one way of writing that down and 1,250 of the 3,125 declared combinations were settled, all agreeing.

rows.text: residual control rights allocation rises with stated purpose commitment, for every stated purpose commitment in [0.00, 1.00].
rows.anno: A firm that commits to a purpose concedes more residual control rights, but only up to a ceiling: the quantity is a share of something finite, so the model caps it. Over the declared range the sign is proved, and the cap is where the relationship stops being smooth. What it does not establish: The cap is the interesting part and it is where the method goes quiet. Not one of the 3,125 declared form combinations could be settled, because the cap makes the expression non-differentiable exactly where it binds: the sign holds at the line that was written and nothing here bears on the class of shapes either way.

rows.text: residual control rights allocation rises with measurement and accountability technology, for every measurement and accountability technology in [0.00, 1.00].
rows.anno: Better measurement and accountability technology increases the rights that can be conceded, because a commitment nobody can verify allocates nothing anybody can rely on. Measurement enters as a modulator, so it multiplies what commitment achieves rather than adding to it: with no measurement, commitment buys nothing at all. What it does not establish: Same silence as the finding above, and for the same reason: the ceiling makes this undecidable over the declared class, so none of the 3,125 combinations was settled. The multiplication is a declaration about where measurement acts, not a measured effect size.

In the governance argument this is the substitution result: a cost charged to one channel does not quietly reduce the other. What it does not establish: Returned rather than proved here, and about the two-channel model rather than about the purpose model this scenario built. It sits on the board because somebody stood behind it, not because this page checked it.

What it does not establish: Returned from another engine, so this page carries it with its provenance and not with a proof of its own. provenance.prompt:
You are helping a management scholar turn a curated literature into a formal
model. Below are the declarations the corpus could not supply. You are PROPOSING; the scholar
accepts, edits or discards, and the page records which of the two of you chose each one.

A relation's ROLE is what the antecedent DOES to the consequent. No paper in this corpus
states one, so this is a modelling decision and the page cannot check it. Use this
vocabulary and nothing outside it:
  generates  ("adds to")  -- a positive direct effect: it creates value or stock that was not there
  dissipates  ("subtracts from")  -- a cost: it destroys value, or charges against it
  transfers  ("moves between")  -- conserved — one holder's gain is another's loss, and the total is unchanged
  allocates  ("divides across")  -- an allocation rule: it splits a quantity over parties or channels
  gates  ("enables")  -- moderation as a necessary condition — below a threshold the other mechanism does nothing
  modulates  ("scales")  -- moderation as magnitude — an interaction: it changes how much another mechanism does

A relation's SHAPE CLASS is what its functional form is committed to. Propose only what the
literature's own statements support, and leave it empty where they support nothing. From
this list only:
increasing   concave   convex   sigmoid   f(0)=0   f(1)=1

A QUANTITY's KIND is what sort of thing it is. From this list only:
  stock  -- an accumulated quantity — knowledge, firm-specific investment
  rate  -- a per-period proportion governing a process
  share  -- a fraction of a whole, summing to one across a set
  degree  -- a normalised position on a designed scale: how much X is done
  propensity  -- an actor's inclination, in [0, 1]
  cost  -- a subtracted quantity
  value  -- a benefit quantity
  threshold  -- a level at which behaviour changes
  diversity  -- a dispersion measure
Its ASPECT is "level" if it is measured absolutely, or "difference" if it is measured
against a baseline and is therefore zero there by construction.

Propose more than one kind where the construct genuinely admits more: these are CLASSES, and
the enumeration runs every member. A narrower class you cannot defend is worse than a wider
one you can.

RELATIONS NEEDING A ROLE:
  id=purpose-clarity-factor>firm-overall-performance   purpose clarity factor -> firm accounting performance   shapes declared: f(0)=0, f(1)=1, increasing
      Purpose–camaraderie factor and firm performance (ROA, Tobin's Q): null
  id=clarity-only-index>firm-overall-performance   clarity only index -> firm accounting performance   shapes declared: f(0)=0, f(1)=1, increasing

  id=prosocial-mission>perceived-work-meaningfulness   prosocial mission -> perceived work meaningfulness   shapes declared: f(0)=0, f(1)=1, increasing
      Authentic purpose makes work meaningful
  id=prosocial-mission>firm-overall-performance   prosocial mission -> firm accounting performance   shapes declared: f(0)=0, f(1)=1, increasing
      Employees of purpose-driven firms are more productive
  id=perceived-work-meaningfulness>firm-overall-performance   perceived work meaningfulness -> firm accounting performance   shapes declared: f(0)=0, f(1)=1, increasing
      Meaningfulness routes purpose to firm performance
QUANTITIES NEEDING A KIND OR AN ASPECT:
  id=clarity-only-index   "clarity only index"
  id=residual-control-rights-allocation   "residual control rights allocation"
  id=measurement-and-accountability-technology   "measurement and accountability technology"
  id=purpose-clarity-factor   "purpose clarity factor"   kind declared: stock, degree
  id=firm-overall-performance   "firm accounting performance"   kind declared: stock, rate, degree
  id=prosocial-mission   "prosocial mission"   kind declared: stock, threshold
  id=perceived-work-meaningfulness   "perceived work meaningfulness"   kind declared: stock, degree
  id=stated-purpose-commitment   "stated purpose commitment"   kind declared: stock, degree

Answer only for the ids listed above, in those exact ids. Do not invent relations,
quantities, roles, shapes or kinds; anything outside the vocabularies is discarded and
counted. One short sentence of why for each role, in the literature's own terms.

literature. Below is every outcome quantity in the model, the mechanisms that write it, the
role each mechanism has been declared to play, and the class of functional shapes it will be
run over.

Propose, for each outcome, how its mechanisms combine. Choose from exactly these five:
  additive        independent contributions; removing one leaves the rest
  multiplicative  each is necessary; take any to zero and the outcome is zero
  min             a bottleneck; the smallest binds
  max             a substitute set; the best is enough
  ces             between additive and multiplicative, elasticity swept

Propose more than one where the theory genuinely does not settle it -- that is a class and
the enumeration will run all of them. Say nothing about outcomes where you have no reason.

Reason from the construct names and the declared roles, not from what sounds plausible in

provenance.prompt:
You are helping a management scholar build a formal model out of a curated
literature. Every declaration below was made by hand. What is missing is the one thing no
declaration fixes, which is the arithmetic.

Write it. One assignment per line, in a grammar that is valid Python AND JavaScript at once,
because the page runs it and checks it before anybody believes it:

  names        lower_snake_case. In scope: the parameters below, any constant you declare, and
               any line you have already written. Nothing else exists -- no attribute access,
               no quotes, no brackets but round ones, no conditionals.
  operators    + - * / **  and the comma inside a call. Parenthesise a leading minus before
               ** : write -(x ** 2), never -x ** 2.
  functions    min(a, b)  max(a, b)  exp(a)  log(a)  and nothing else.
  numbers      decimals with a leading digit: 0.5, never .5.

Write exactly one line per TERM the brief names, named exactly as it names it, reading the
parameter it is declared to read. Then exactly one line per OUTCOME, named exactly as the brief
names it, combining its own terms the way its composition is declared:
  additive  they add    multiplicative  they multiply    min  the smallest binds
  max  the largest carries    ces  between the two, as a weighted power mean

What each declared word requires of your expression. The brief marks every term with the
shape words that were declared for it, and these six are the only ones that can be:
  f(0)=0       zero where its reader sits at the bottom of its declared range
  f(1)=1       one at the top of that range, so swapping a form moves the shape and not
               the scale -- which is what lets a broken obligation be attributed
  increasing   rises in what it reads, everywhere in the reader's range
  concave      rises with a falling slope -- diminishing returns
  convex       rises with a rising slope -- a compounding cost
  sigmoid      changes curvature exactly once: slow, then rapid, then saturating
And the six role words, which say how a term enters the outcome it writes:
  generates    enters positively: it creates value that was not there
  dissipates   enters negatively: a cost, charged against the outcome
  transfers    conserved -- what it adds to one quantity it takes from another
  allocates    an allocation rule: it splits a quantity over parties or channels
  gates        lies in [0, 1] and MULTIPLIES the term it acts on, which the brief names
  modulates    multiplies the term it acts on, unbounded -- an interaction
A term whose shape is unconstrained is yours to choose. Say what you chose and why, in one
sentence that names what in the declarations decided it.

Where the brief lists FORM FAMILIES for a term, a member of one is the better answer than
an expression of your own: the page can then run the WHOLE family against your model and
report whether the conclusion holds for the class or only for the line you wrote. Name it --
"family" and "member" beside the line -- and a constant in front is allowed. Name a family
only if the line really is that member: a class the line is not in is worse than no class.

A CLASS OF ONE IS A CLAIM, AND IT IS THE STRONGEST ONE HERE. The "linear" family holds a
single member, so naming it pins the shape exactly: it asserts that there is no curvature,
rather than declining to assert any. If the declarations and the corpus say nothing about
the curvature of a term, the WEAKER answer is the family whose properties you are willing
to assert, with the member you think likeliest named inside it; the page then reads every
conclusion against all of its members and reports the share that agree. Name "linear" where
proportionality is the content of the claim -- an allocation rule splitting a quantity pro
rata is exactly that -- and say so in the reason. Do not reach for it as the modest answer
to "nothing is known", because in this vocabulary it is the least modest answer available.

EVERY MEMBER READS X ON [0, 1]. So X is not the reader itself unless the reader's declared
range IS [0, 1]: where the brief gives a parameter some other range, write
((reader - lo) / (hi - lo)) in place of X. Substituting the raw reader breaks f(0)=0 and
f(1)=1 -- the two properties the family claims -- and the page will say so.

Give every weight a name as a constant, and give each one the INTERVAL it should be run over
as well as a value: "lo" and "hi", the range over which you would still expect the model to
behave as the declarations say. That interval is what lets a conclusion be proved over the
weights rather than merely at the ones you picked, and nothing in the corpus fixes a weight,
so the range is a judgement and it should be a wide one rather than a flattering one. Keep the
weights few, and keep every outcome inside its declared bounds everywhere in the box.
